test_item:
DebugAuth shall verify certificate
(SAM certificate is x509 PEM, chains to the OEM issued root, and carries the SAM subject)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. AuthData of group X-g is available on a USB drive
input: SAM certificate SAMcert.pem in x509 PEM format, signed by the OEM issued root certificate
proc:
1. Read the SAM certificate format and subject on the host
$ openssl x509 -in SAMcert.pem -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the SAM certificate against the OEM issued root chain
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. Confirm DebugAuth accepts the SAM certificate
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#samCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
er:
1. The openssl output shows the certificate is in PEM form and its `Subject:` line carries the SAM market field
2. The openssl command prints `SAMcert.pem: OK` on stdout
3. The instrumentation runner reports `OK (1 test)` for samCertTestNormalFlow
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-SAM-0007 Verification Criteria 3.1/3.2/3.3 (037 wording granularity, R-SEC8(h)); Test_Items.txt #04
batch: manual override per R-SEC12 (apk samCertTestNormalFlow). SAM tree cert profile is reference only (DR-SEC-q). channel_feasible = N — sampled per SEC-02 §8 constraint
apk pairing: high (apk_pairing.tsv #04)
